data.title: 烧盐柠檬 · 空教室里被擦汗的瞬间慌乱
data.description: 放学后空无一人的教室窗口，当少年用毛巾轻柔按在她汗湿的颈侧时，平时大咧咧的田径少女身体猛地一僵，小麦色脸庞腾起大片红晕，害羞得眼神飘忽结结巴巴。
data.location: empty sunlit classroom by open window with fluttering curtains
data.action: standing by classroom window as partner wipes sweat from her collarbone with a towel, blushing furiously with wide shy eyes and trembling smile
data.lighting: warm afternoon sunlight streaming through window onto tanned skin
data.mood: adorable gap moe, sudden romantic awareness, sweet adolescent vulnerability
data.promptProse: In an empty sunny classroom, Lemon Yakishio blushes intensely as partner gently wipes sweat from her cheek with a towel, eyes wide with shy realization.
data.animaCaption: Lemon Yakishio blushing furiously while partner wipes her face with towel.
